notes.title: Next Fest! 🎉
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44987954/2fb6c9170e2bacb022da92099d9bbee07ca57199.png"][/img]
Hello city-building enthusiasts!

We’re happy to announce that the [b]demo for [i]The Whims of the Gods[/i] is now live on Steam! [/b]To celebrate this special moment, we’re also thrilled to unveil our [b]brand-new official trailer[/b]. It captures the spirit, tension, and beauty of shaping a civilization under divine watch - building, surviving, and facing the unpredictable whims of ancient gods. [b]Check out the newest trailer! [/b]In this free demo, you’ll begin your journey in a world where a new civilization takes root. Whether playing solo or with a friend in online co-op, your mission is to lead your people, manage their needs, and navigate the blessings and burdens from the gods above.

[b]Here’s what you can expect to experience:[/b] \[/p][/p][list][*][p] Construct and expand your city with a variety of early-game buildings[/p][/*][*][p] Set up food chains, gather resources, and meet your people's evolving demands[/p][/*][*][p] Make meaningful tech decisions that shape your civilization's direction[/p][/*][*][p] Explore a handcrafted map shrouded in fog[/p][/*][*][p] Invoke the gods for blessings or risk provoking their wrath[/p][/*][*][p] Survive core challenges like hunger, happiness, and housing stability[/p][/*][*][p] Play alone or in [b]online two-player co-op[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]

[img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2642390/extras/GIF_miasto_marzen.gif?t=1744873419"][/img][/p][p]To make the most of this demo phase, we’ve set up a [b]dedicated feedback channel right here on Steam[/b]. If you run into issues, have suggestions, or just want to share your thoughts, we’d love to hear from you. Your feedback is crucial as we shape the path forward!

[url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2642390/discussions/2/"]Drop your feedback here[/url] and let us know what you think![/p][p][/p][p]If you enjoy your time with the demo, we’d be incredibly grateful if you left a quick review. It helps spread the word and gives the game more visibility - it really does make a difference.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960200/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thanks again for being here at the beginning of this journey. We can’t wait to hear how your civilization fares under the watchful eyes of the gods. But... we’ve also got some exciting news! We have officially partnered with [url="https://crytivo.com/"]Crytivo[/url], a publisher known for supporting player-focused games and vibrant communities.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44987954/4fe652a4a7f1162d9ce9a4037e6fe4e53c8cd78b.png"][/img][/p][p]
Crytivo is a company that has gained recognition in the market, combining experimentation with different genres and the search for new and exceptional experiences. They’re also loved for their open communication with players and regular game updates. Gamers across the world, and dedicated gaming communities, already know Crytivo for backing some truly beloved projects. Now, we’re proud to be joining forces with them![/p][p]
We hope you will enjoy the demo! Make sure to follow us here on [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2642390/The_Whims_of_the_Gods/"]Steam[/url] or [url="https://discord.gg/FBBczkkFtr"]Discord[/url] to stay up to date with the game news! Also, make sure to wishlist the main game if you like it! [/p][p][/p][p]Best,[/p][p]Juggler Games / PJ GAMES Team [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2642390/The_Whims_of_the_Gods/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.content:
[h1]💌 Summary 💌[/h1]
Love is in the air ❤️ So here we come to you with a new update and a loveeeelyyy deal :)
Let's start with the deal and then move on to the content of the update
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50461/Valentines_Week_Time_Limited_Feb_1421/
Two Games, My Memory of Us, and Tarnished Blood FOR ONE PRICE! But make haste! Bundle remains active ONLY UNTIL FEB 20TH

Perfect for:
✅ Players who crave emotional depth AND strategic challenges.
✅ Gift-seekers tired of cliché chocolates & teddy bears.
✅ Anyone who believes love stories can be…epic.

💞 Why Grab This Bundle?
My Memory of Us – A tear-jerking tale of war, friendship, and impossible choices.
Tarnished Blood – Tactical battles where every move decides life or death.
Two worlds, one price – The ultimate duo for a cozy gaming night!
⏳ Don’t wait! Steam won’t rewind time like your game saves…

[h1]🔎 Update Log 🔎[/h1]
[h3]Added:[/h3]
📌Steam Activities Integration
📌New Valentine's item with a low possibility of dropping from any boss

📌Fixed colors of the first and second characters in the party being incorrect after loading fights from the menu
📌Corrected camera target of bosses to reflect their center instead of feet
📌Meadow of Death event had D6 dice used for rolling instead of D10
📌Missing event name in Overcharged event
📌Missing word in Divine tribe description
📌Fixed Gather Resource event in Divine and Royal tribe missing some outcome text
📌Shield/Hammer had wrong interactions with disabled enemy hitboxes causing fast bullets to ignore the "1 frame immunity" character has if blocking or swinging hammer in some specific situations
📌Galvera's bleeding/spit and Caretakers acidic spit had slightly bigger colliders after specific recalculations (very minor difference)
📌Fixed Arda's Starbow not having recoil if shooting while jumping through a platform
📌Minor Animation glitches while jumping through a platform
📌Fixed Starchild Sun's ability to change direction when spawning after a specific set of recalculations
📌Fixed how saves are formatted to avoid problems with different decimal separators across multiple countries

New Boss soon :)

notes.title: Public playtests are open | The Whims of the Gods! 🏝️
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30847552/dc777512626917efdeeb1bf9cc55a7acca8313be.jpg[/img]

We are thrilled to announce that [b]from today until February 7th[/b] the second public playtests for The Whims of the Gods are available on its Steam page!

This strategic, cooperative city-builder invites you and your friend to construct and defend an ancient city together. Experience unique co-op gameplay, manage resources, and face challenges sent by whimsical deities.

[b]How to do it in a few simple steps?[/b]
[list]
[*] go to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2642390/The_Whims_of_the_Gods/]Steam The Whims of the Gods tab[/url] 
[*] click the "REQUEST ACCESS" button or...
[*] [url=https://discord.com/invite/FBBczkkFtr]join our community on Discord[/url], select the emoji 🎮 accepting our rules, and tag our admins there so that they can give you a key to the game
[/list]
[b]Your feedback is invaluable to us as we refine the game ahead of its release. You can:[/b] 
[list]
[*] leave it on the Steam tab in discussions ([b]this particular thread is visible only to accounts that receive the game code![/b]) or 
[*] on the appropriate, playtest-dedicated channel on our Discord
[/list]
We look forward to hearing your thoughts. Let's create the best possible city-builder game in the world together!

notes.title: Patrick Stewart will narrate My Memory of Us, a game about children in the Holocaust
notes.content:
My Memory of Us caught my attention early last year with a trailer revealing a visual style reminiscent of old-fashioned Disney animated shorts. It slyly subverts the game's setting, a Jewish ghetto in Poland during the Second World War, but it's also perfectly appropriate because the game world is seen through the eyes of children: German soldiers are seen as mindless robots, for instance, and the vicious antisemitism of adults remains an unlearned mystery among children. 

A new trailer today expands upon its promise of a "unique, emotional" game by showcasing the talents of the narrator, announced today as Patrick Stewart, a name you may recognize from The Elder Scrolls 4: Oblivion—Stewart portrayed Emperor Uriel Septim VII—or the 1981 cinematic classic Excalibur. He's also won awards for his work with the internationally renowned Royal Shakespeare Company. 

"The story of My Memory of Us is a personal one to us, as our grandparents faced similar oppression World War 2. This game is our ode to them and the millions of others who lived and died during this time," Juggler Games CEO Mikołaj Pawłowski said. 

"So when it came time to cast a narrator, Patrick Stewart was the perfect choice. His amazing acting career spans nearly six decades, and since the very beginning he has produced incredible and emotional work. His talent and skill provides the right mixture of gravitas and hope, and his performance resonates perfectly with our game." 

While obviously fictionalized, My Memory of Us is based on real events that occurred during the war: The City, where the game begins, is "inspired" by pre-WW2 Warsaw, and events shown in the game will be based on "actual stories from the war." Mechanically, the game will be built around "logic puzzles in 2.5D," but the story promises "deeper meaning, set in historical realities." 

My Memory of Us is scheduled to come out on October 9. You can learn more about the game at mymemoryofus.com.

notes.title: Legendary actor joins My Memory of Us and reveals the final release date!
notes.content:
[b]Hi Gamers,[/b]

We can officially announce that [b]My Memory of Us[/b] launches [b]October 9, 2018 on PC, PlayStation®4 and Xbox One[/b]! Additionally, our game will feature the golden voice of legendary actor of stage and screen, [b]Patrick Stewart[/b].

[b]My Memory of Us[/b] is a puzzle-based, side-scrolling story game of hope and heroism in the face of absolute terror. Story, narrated by [b]Patrick Stewart[/b] begins in [b]The City[/b] - a place inspired by [b]pre-Second World War Warsaw[/b], where a young boy and girl from two different worlds come together to be kids, free to play and enjoy life. War breaks out and the children, faced with forced separation, with your help, may find a way to stay together and  survive the threat of the evil occupation of their world.  

[i]“The story of My Memory of Us is a personal one to us, as our grandparents faced similar oppression World War II. This game is our ode to  them and the millions of others who lived and died during this time,”[/i] said [b]Mikołaj Pawłowski, CEO, Juggler Games[/b]. [i]“So when it came time to cast a  narrator, Patrick Stewart was the perfect choice. His amazing acting career spans nearly six decades, and since the very beginning he has produced incredible and emotional work. His talent and skill provides the right mixture of gravitas and hope, and his performance resonates perfectly with our game.” [/i]

[b]Patrick Stewart’s[/b] illustrious career has produced unforgettable performances from his award-winning roles with the Royal Shakespeare Company to his work as [b]Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek: The Next Generation and as Professor Charles Xavier in the X-Men film series[/b]. [b]My Memory of Us[/b] marks his return to the video game format, having previously lent his voice acting talents to titles that include [b]The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion. [/b]

[b]Youtube Patrick Stewart Video Trailer:[/b] https://youtu.be/di18oL5oCic
[h1]My Memory of Us Features:[/h1]
[list][*]A moving story about friendship and love in dangerous times	
[*]Beautiful, sketch-like graphics inspired by naïve art 
[*]Pair mechanics: take control of two separate? characters with different skills and abilities, or control them as a pair 
[*]A grotesque tale mixed with bittersweet humor  
[*]The events shown in the game are based on actual stories from war  
[*]A dialogue system built around the language of symbolic pictures  
[*]Various logical puzzles in 2.5D  
[*]A story that offers deeper meaning, set in historical realities
[*]SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS: Windows 10[/list]

[b]We can't wait to show you the full game,[/b]
[i]Juggler Games and IMGN.PRO[/i]
